_about: A fictional 'check before you post' bundle: a social post claims a town banned bicycles; the council minutes it cites say something narrower. Every name here is invented. retrieved_at is filled in by the agent at post time when absent.

sources.title: Viral post: 'Brackenridge just BANNED bicycles downtown'

excerpts.text: Brackenridge just BANNED bicycles downtown. Share before they delete this.
Motion 14 carried: cycling is prohibited on the Market Street pedestrian mall between 10:00 and 18:00 on Saturdays during the December market season. Bicycles may be walked.

claims.text: Brackenridge prohibits cycling on the Market Street pedestrian mall on Saturday daytimes during the December market season.

evidence.statement: The post asserts a downtown bicycle ban without citing a decision.
Motion 14 prohibits cycling only on the Market Street mall on Saturday daytimes in the December market season; bicycles may be walked.

links.note: The minutes describe a narrow, seasonal, time-limited restriction, not a downtown ban.
The post is the claim's origin, not evidence for it.
